svg.title: WEBD 1000 Fall 2026 website project roadmap
svg.desc: Eight illustrated phases from project brief and wireframes through HTML, CSS, responsive design, device testing, accessibility validation, and final publication.

g.text: Seven milestones take one website from the initial brief to the final published submission.
Write a clear title and a 2–3 sentence purpose.
Identify your audience and at least three user needs or tasks.
Plan at least three pages and the content each will provide.
Figma brief and initial design direction.
Separate GitHub repository named for the site, with a README.
Can you explain how the planned pages support the audience’s tasks?
Map the home page and at least two additional pages in Figma.
Wireframe home and one secondary page for both mobile and desktop.
Label header, navigation, main content, call to action, and footer.
README with the planned structure and Figma link.
Do the sitemap and wireframes agree on navigation and content hierarchy?
Build and deploy the first site
Build index.html and at least two additional HTML pages.
Use semantic landmarks, logical headings, descriptive links, and
Match the Figma plan and enable GitHub Pages.
Working HTML pages linked to each other.
Open the live homepage and follow every navigation link.
Link one external stylesheet on every page.
Define reusable colour, typography, and spacing tokens.
Style navigation, hero, content, links, buttons, and footer. Use
Styled live site with reusable CSS.
Compare the live styling with Figma and check components across pages.
Make navigation work at narrow widths.
Use flexible sizing, media queries, and responsive Flexbox or Grid.
Update Figma mobile and desktop frames to match your decisions.
Responsive live site and updated Figma frames.
Short list of viewport widths tested.
Test about 320, 375, 768, and 1280 px. Check that content fits without
Test every page and key navigation path on mobile, tablet, and
Check links, images, overflow, readability, and basic keyboard
Fix at least two genuine issues or document convincing evidence if
Test log with viewport or browser, issue, fix, and retest result.
Check that the live GitHub Pages site reflects the latest commit.
Validate every HTML page with W3C Nu and check CSS with the W3C CSS
Fix errors and explain remaining warnings.
Review headings, alt text, link text, form labels where applicable,
Accessibility and validation record with screenshots or links.
Corrected site deployed to GitHub Pages.
Recheck the deployed fixes and retain evidence of the final results.
Publish home and at least two meaningful pages with consistent
navigation, an introduction, and footer navigation or a sitemap.
Resolve major functional, validation, and accessibility issues.
Verify the live site at multiple widths.
Update Figma and the README with the final design and project
Final live site, repository, and Figma links.
Open submission links privately. Check that the site and evidence are
BRIGHTSPACE • M1–M2 Figma + project repository | M3 onward Add the live GitHub Pages URL | Include phase-specific evidence and verify links in a private window.
